## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 7 dishes, none Togo-only.
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 4 dishes shared with Nigeria/Benin (yam porridge, pounded yam, akara, mashed beans).
- [[FmLAMA]]: 1 dish (djenkoumé).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Togo; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 104 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 21 ethnobotany records (13 taxa).
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Togo on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Togo-only dishes; Ewe and Kabye food absent.
- WAFCT not yet processed.
